caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron bench situated in an indoor or outdoor setting. The bench is composed of two symmetrical, decorative legs, each featuring a series of large and small spirals or curls, connected by a horizontal support bar near the floor and a diagonal support bar that meets at the center. The seating surface appears to be made of wood, depicted with wood grain texture. In the background, on the right side, there is a tall, narrow vase containing a leafy plant with trailing stems. The background consists of shaded and unshaded areas, possibly suggesting walls and floor surfaces, rendered with hatching lines. The image is monochrome, using only black ink lines on an off-white paper background. The bottom right corner contains the title “WROUGHT IRON BENCH” in capital letters. The image is enclosed by a thin black rectangular border with rounded corners.
title: Wrought Iron Garden Bench
